title: How to Beat Fuzan in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 — Boss Fight Guide
author: GamerCory
description:
How to Beat Fuzan in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0 — Boss Fight Guide.

Fuzan is the dragon boss in Umbral Sands, and this guide focuses on taking him down once you’ve reached his lair.

In this guide, I’ll walk you through my Fuzan fight, showing how I handled his attacks and found opportunities to deal damage so you can get past him and keep progressing in RuneScape Dragonwilds 1.0.
